scope: Repository restructuring only; no recovery promotion, modernization, enhancement integration, hardware or headless implementation
deadline: Six-month project goal across all three milestones; dependency-ordered acceptance, not speculative week estimates

milestones.goal: Reliable native GT3 on the actual simulator
requirements: stable gameplay performance and frame pacing
milestones.acceptance: Actual hardware and defined representative gameplay matrix; not every car, track, mode or peripheral

milestones.goal: Correct headless AI training using shared authoritative gameplay
requirements: recorded headless races playable in the actual 3D environment
milestones.replay: Matching simulation version, configuration and numerical contract; incompatible versions may reject; format undecided

milestones.goal: Complete playable GT3 engine without PS2 execution or equivalent instruction translation machinery in gameplay
milestones.priority: Lowest; current selective recovery does not redefine the complete-game destination

classifications.Original: Original GT3 behavior through generated code and PS2 runtime; permanent reference
classifications.Recovered: Readable reconstruction independently validated against original, including applicable ABI/mutation/numerical/cost contracts
classifications.Modernized: Native replacement of PS2-specific mechanisms after recovery; approved observable original gameplay behavior
classifications.Enhanced / Extended: Explicit intentional additions or changes beyond original behavior

ps2run.updates: Reviewed rolling infrastructure updates with qualified identities and evidence

gt3-native.enhancement_policy: May eventually compile/link enhancements, disabled by default with demonstrated inactive neutrality
gt3-native.existing_virtual_transmission: Preserve current build/runtime gates until separate validated integration
gt3-native.initial_execution: Same accepted original execution; no implicit recovered substitutions

headless.role: Future separate host, not implemented by restructuring
headless.gameplay: Same authoritative implementations and gameplay build settings as playable

ownership.layout: Hybrid; gameplay domains together; hosts, PS2 bindings and platform infrastructure separate
ownership.other_documentation_exceptions: Only explicitly necessary exceptions, including legally required license/notices
ownership.inherited: Preserve recomp/runtime internal organization; shared infrastructure, no duplicate runtime checkouts
ownership.temporary_parallel_execution: Bounded migration/validation only; observable tested fallback with explicit scope and exit criteria
ownership.promotion: Case-by-case explicit boundary; implementation proof distinct from product approval
ownership.replacement: Remove superseded execution within promoted scope and ultimately its link inputs; retain normal playable coverage before fallback retirement
ownership.unsupported_contexts: Safe explicit product-level response; no silent superseded execution within promoted scope

modification_policy.modernization: Separate approval may replace guest accounting/scheduling with native timing/ordering/outcome contract
modification_policy.numerics: Explicitly approved per-component differences require stateful race-level evidence; existing tolerances unchanged
modification_policy.mechanical_relocation: Separate from behavior changes and structural extraction of mixed files

workflow.target: Coordinated graph with explicit authoritative source/dependency ownership
workflow.migration: Existing isolated builders migrate in validated phases
workflow.infrastructure: Explicit targets and lightweight checks; no plugin system, universal simulation API or speculative framework
workflow.tests: Domain-local unit/contracts; central independent original differentials, cross-domain integration and live support
workflow.authorities: Central multiple records; implementation proof separate from product approval; conservative dependency-aware stale invalidation
workflow.documentation: Site-centered maintained prose; generated structured status views

preservation.private_context: Hashed immutable bundles for evaluated overlays, unavailable generated artifacts, private fixtures and required toolchain material
preservation.requirements: Complete explicit source/build/dependency/validation context; independent backup and restore verification
preservation.missing_or_mismatched: Fail explicitly; never skip, rewrite historical hashes or substitute active versions
preservation.current_builds: Fresh public clone plus legal ISO and documented discovery/regeneration; no dependence on historical workspace

validation.ordinary_changes: Applicable public build, unit/contracts, authority consistency, boundaries, publication and docs
validation.product_changes: Invalidate stale approvals; relevant private differentials and native matrices
validation.uncertain_or_shared_impact: Broader validation or fail closed for approval; not directory-only selection
validation.first_runnable_checkpoint: Both products fresh-clone regenerate/build and reproduce complete retained bounded matrix; not full-game compatibility or recovery promotion
validation.explicit_private_verification: Required unavailable or changed evidence fails clearly
validation.public_development: No proprietary fixtures required; ordinary passing gates do not authorize integration

limitations: This approved policy is not proof or product integration approval.
Mutable execution progress is separate derived reporting; it cannot approve source or change preserved expectations.
Historical pin extraction alone is not a complete audit of arbitrary verifier code.
